scope: Read-only rereview of the corrected generic publisher; no production publication was run.

priorFailureResolution.failure: PASS reviews were not verified against the current cohort and product hashes.
priorFailureResolution.evidence: validate() requires each hash-bound review to have verdict PASS, the manifest cohort, and a boundProducts/products ID-to-SHA map exactly equal to the publication manifest product set. Stale or foreign same-ID review bytes are rejected.

priorFailureResolution.failure: Term rollback bookkeeping began after destructive operations.
priorFailureResolution.evidence: For replacement mode the complete target is backed up first, then the identity enters installed_terms before target deletion. Create mode likewise enters rollback tracking before target creation or any move. Every later exception removes the partial target and restores the backup when present.

priorFailureResolution.failure: Public graph parity checked counts rather than identity and content.
priorFailureResolution.evidence: _verify_public now requires unique rich and shard IDs, exact shard_by_id == rich by_id content, exact ordered rich-to-index term/target parity, exact ordered rich-to-legacy term/target parity, aggregate count parity, and exact selected-product hashes.

priorFailureResolution.failure: Detected roster drift was not restored.
priorFailureResolution.evidence: install() snapshots the roster before any mutation. Any exception path compares its hash and restores the byte backup before re-raising.

priorFailureResolution.failure: Receipt-write failure could leave installed terms/public without a receipt.
priorFailureResolution.evidence: The install receipt is written inside the protected transaction after parity, integrity, and roster checks. Any write failure unlinks the final receipt and rolls back public, terms, and roster state.
